STRING.note: String length may need adjustment for the target application.

TIME_OF_DAY.note: Siemens uses TOD; internal representation differs.

ANY.note: ANY has no exact S7 equivalent; mapped to Variant.

SR.note: TriStation SR flip-flop is not a TIA data type; SupportBlockGenerator emits Triconex_SR with the same formal names (reset-dominant). Verify the reset/set priority against the reference.

RS.note: TriStation RS flip-flop is not a TIA data type; SupportBlockGenerator emits Triconex_RS with the same formal names (set-dominant). Verify the reset/set priority against the reference.

LOG.note: TIA has neither a base-10 LOG FBD box nor an SCL LOG function; rendered as LN(x)/LN(10). Verify against the reference for each operand.

POW.note: TriStation POW becomes the TIA FBD Expt box; in SCL the exponentiation operator ** is used. Verify the operand types.

MUX.note: TriStation MUX names its data inputs IN2..IN4 (K = 0 selects IN2); TIA MUX names them IN0..IN2 (K = 0 selects IN0), so the inputs are renamed at the call site. The select semantics are identical.

MOVE.note: TIA SCL has no MOVE function; inlined as a plain assignment. Check operand types at each call site.

AND.note: Rendered as the AND operator: TIA rejects keyword-style AND(...) calls.

OR.note: Rendered as the OR operator: TIA rejects keyword-style OR(...) calls.

XOR.note: Rendered as the XOR operator: TIA rejects keyword-style XOR(...) calls.

NOT.note: Rendered as the NOT operator: TIA rejects keyword-style NOT(IN1 := ...) calls.

ADD.note: Rendered with the + operator: TIA rejects keyword-style ADD(...) calls.

SUB.note: Rendered with the - operator: TIA rejects keyword-style SUB(...) calls.

MUL.note: Rendered with the * operator: TIA rejects keyword-style MUL(...) calls.

DIV.note: Rendered with the / operator: TIA rejects keyword-style DIV(...) calls.

MOD.note: Rendered with the MOD operator: TIA rejects keyword-style MOD(...) calls. Check the sign handling for negative operands.

GE.note: Rendered with the >= operator: TIA has no Cmp_GE function.

GT.note: Rendered with the > operator: TIA has no Cmp_GT function.

LE.note: Rendered with the <= operator: TIA has no Cmp_LE function.

LT.note: Rendered with the < operator: TIA has no Cmp_LT function.

EQ.note: Rendered with the = operator: TIA has no Cmp_EQ function.

NE.note: Rendered with the <> operator: TIA has no Cmp_NE function.

SHL.note: TIA rejects positional SHL(...) arguments; rendered with the named IN/N formals. Check the operand width.

SHR.note: TIA rejects positional SHR(...) arguments; rendered with the named IN/N formals. Check the operand width.

ROL.note: TIA has no rotate FBD box; rendered as the SCL ROL function with the named IN/N formals. Check the operand width.

ROR.note: TIA has no rotate FBD box; rendered as the SCL ROR function with the named IN/N formals. Check the operand width.

TIME_TO_SECS_REAL.note: TriStation 1131 TIME_TO_SECS_REAL function: returns a TIME as REAL seconds. TIA has no single instruction for it, so it is inlined as the TIME's millisecond count divided by 1000.0.

PACK16.note: TriStation 1131 PACK16 function: w := PACK16(IN01..IN16) returns a DWORD holding all 16 bits, IN01 in the least significant bit and IN16 the most significant bit.
PACK16.inline: BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN01}) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN02}), N := 1) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN03}), N := 2) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN04}), N := 3) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN05}), N := 4) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN06}), N := 5) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN07}), N := 6) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN08}), N := 7) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN09}), N := 8) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN10}), N := 9) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN11}), N := 10) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN12}), N := 11) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN13}), N := 12) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN14}), N := 13) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN15}), N := 14) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN16}), N := 15)

UNPACK16.note: TriStation 1131 UNPACK16 function block (VAR x : UNPACK16): inputs CI (BOOL, enables the block) and INPUT (DWORD); outputs CO (BOOL), NZ (BOOL, true if any bit is true) and Q01..Q16 where Q01 is the least significant bit of the low-order 16 bits and Q16 the most significant. It is an instance, not an inline function, and must be called exactly once per scan. No Siemens library block matches it, so SupportBlockGenerator emits Triconex_UNPACK16 with the same formal names; the call site needs no parameter rewriting. CO follows CI because the reference defines it only as "true if UNPACK16 executes successfully"; the Q outputs keep their previous value while CI is false, as the block is then not executed.

PACK32.note: TriStation 1131 PACK32 function: w := PACK32(IN01..IN32) returns a DWORD holding all 32 bits, IN01 in the least significant bit and IN32 the most significant bit.
PACK32.inline: BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN01}) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN02}), N := 1) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN03}), N := 2) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN04}), N := 3) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN05}), N := 4) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN06}), N := 5) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN07}), N := 6) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN08}), N := 7) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN09}), N := 8) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN10}), N := 9) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN11}), N := 10) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN12}), N := 11) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN13}), N := 12) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN14}), N := 13) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN15}), N := 14) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN16}), N := 15) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN17}), N := 16) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN18}), N := 17) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN19}), N := 18) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN20}), N := 19) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN21}), N := 20) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN22}), N := 21) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN23}), N := 22) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN24}), N := 23) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN25}), N := 24) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN26}), N := 25) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN27}), N := 26) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN28}), N := 27) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN29}), N := 28) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN30}), N := 29) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN31}), N := 30) OR SHL(IN := BOOL_TO_DWORD({IN32}), N := 31)

UNPACK32.note: TriStation 1131 UNPACK32 function block (VAR x : UNPACK32): inputs CI (BOOL, enables the block) and INPUT (DWORD); outputs CO (BOOL), NZ (BOOL, true if any bit is true) and Q01..Q32 where Q01 is the least significant bit and Q32 the most significant. It is an instance, not an inline function, and must be called exactly once per scan. No Siemens library block matches it, so SupportBlockGenerator emits Triconex_UNPACK32 with the same formal names; the call site needs no parameter rewriting. Unlike UNPACK16 this reads all 32 bits of INPUT. CO follows CI because the reference defines it only as "true if UNPACK32 executes successfully"; the Q outputs keep their previous value while CI is false, as the block is then not executed.

SCALE.note: TriStation 1131 SCALE function: y := SCALE(INPUT, MAX1, MIN1, MAX2, MIN2) returns a REAL computed as ((INPUT - MIN1)/(MAX1 - MIN1)) * (MAX2 - MIN2) + MIN2. The Siemens SCALE block has a different parameter set, so it cannot be substituted directly.

TDD_I.note: TriStation 1131 TDD_I function block: inputs I1 (BOOL, input state) and TGT (DINT, delay in integer milliseconds); output Q1 (BOOL). Q1 follows I1 true immediately, then stays true for TGT milliseconds after I1 goes false, which is exactly the behaviour of the Siemens TOF; only the millisecond count needs converting to TIME.

TP_I.note: TriStation 1131 TP_I function block: inputs IN (BOOL, pulse to trigger on) and PT (DINT, pulse width in integer milliseconds); output Q (BOOL). The rising edge of IN sets Q and Q stays true for PT milliseconds while further edges are ignored, which is the behaviour of the Siemens TP; only the millisecond count needs converting to TIME.

TR_PID.note: No Siemens equivalent. Use the PID_Compact instruction.

TR_PIDE.note: No Siemens equivalent. Use the PID_Compact instruction.
